title: Desktop Lighting Studio effect look
description: Parametric lighting-look definition (presets/effects/<id>.effect.json). The file basename (<id>.effect.json) must equal "id". Layers composite in order over the emitter's painted color. Deterministic: numeric fields may carry remix specs that draw from the scene's remix seed — draws consume the seed's stream in document order (layers array order, then field order inside each layer object). Units: meters, seconds.

id.description: Look id — must equal the file basename (<id>.effect.json).

numberOrRemix.description: A literal number, or one remix spec object drawing from the seed stream: {"remix":[lo,hi]} -> Range(lo,hi); {"remix01":true} -> Next01(); {"remix_angle":true} -> Angle(); {"remix_neg":[lo,hi]} -> -Range(lo,hi); {"remix_pick":[a,b]} -> Next01()<0.5 ? a : b.

vec3OrRemix.description: An [x,y,z] array (elements may themselves be scalar remix specs), or {"remix_yaw":[x,y,z,lo,hi]} -> RotateYaw(Normalize({x,y,z}), Range(lo,hi)) — direction fields only.

pos.description: Stop position 0..1; stops must be strictly increasing.

layer.description: One parametric field + how it composites. All fields optional; unspecified fields take EffectLayer defaults (primitive "static", space "world", blend "replace", opacity 1, speed 1, scale 0.5, phase 0, density 1, origin {0,0,0}, direction {1,0,0}, empty path/palette/targets, source "", seed 0, enabled true).

opacity.description: Coverage multiplier 0..1 (intensity slider multiplies on top).

speed.description: Primitive motion rate (m/s, rev/s, ...). The global speed slider multiplies on top.

scale.description: Wavelength / ring spacing / noise frequency / spoke count / comet tail length / ripple band half-width / screenfield width (m). Must be > 0.

density.description: Band sharpness / noise contrast / ripple decay (1/s). >= 0.

origin.description: pulse/comet/spin center; ripple spawn for position-less events; screenfield screen center.

direction.description: wave/gradient axis; noise wind. remix_yaw allowed here.

palette.description: Interpolated color stops, pos strictly increasing. Omit entirely when the primitive never samples color — a present-but-empty palette is an error.

targets.description: Object ids, geometry tags, emitter groups; empty = every device object.

source.description: Which input events feed a ripple ("" = all).

seed.description: Per-layer deterministic variation: an unsigned 32-bit literal, or {"remix_u32":[lo,hi]} -> integer draw ([0,4294967295] maps to Next() verbatim).

enabled.description: false = the layer composites nothing (layer-stack editor on/off).
